summary: Comprehensive testing of News Module (Phase 1 News & zentrale Kommunikation). All 29 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend tests passed - News page loads correctly with feed, search, sort tabs, filter chips, editor dialog, detail view with reactions, comments, and read confirmation.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

critical_code_review_comments: Code correctly implements all requested News module features:
- Backend: POST /api/news/categories creates category with name and color ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/categories returns all categories ✓
- Backend: POST /api/news/posts creates news post with title, content, priority, status, targeting ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/feed returns published posts filtered by user groups, sorted by pinned+date ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/feed?search=xxx filters posts by search term ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/feed?priority=critical filters by priority ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/feed?sort=relevance sorts by mandatory+priority+date ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/posts/{post_id} returns single post with reaction counts and read status ✓
- Backend: PUT /api/news/posts/{post_id} updates a post ✓
- Backend: POST /api/news/posts/{post_id}/publish changes status to published ✓
- Backend: POST /api/news/posts/{post_id}/archive changes status to archived ✓
- Backend: POST /api/news/posts/{post_id}/read marks post as read ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/posts/{post_id}/reads returns read receipts with count ✓
- Backend: POST /api/news/posts/{post_id}/reactions toggles reaction (like/agree/helpful) ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/posts/{post_id}/comments returns comments ✓
- Backend: POST /api/news/posts/{post_id}/comments adds a comment ✓
- Backend: DELETE /api/news/comments/{comment_id} soft-deletes a comment ✓
- Backend: GET /api/news/unread-count returns unread and mandatory_unread counts ✓
- Backend: POST /api/news/upload uploads file and returns URL ✓
- Frontend: News page loads with feed, search, sort tabs, filter chips ✓
- Frontend: Clicking news post opens detail view with reactions, comments, read confirmation ✓
- Frontend: News editor dialog creates/publishes news with all fields ✓
- Frontend: Reaction buttons (like/agree/helpful) toggle correctly ✓
- Frontend: Comment submission and display works ✓
- Frontend: Filter chips (Alle, Normal, Wichtig, Kritisch, category) work ✓
- Frontend: Sort tabs (Aktuell, Relevanz, Prioritaet) work ✓
